name: kensho
description: Connect Kensho to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Kensho MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Kensho to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with s&P Global financial data using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Kensho workspace.
Find anything in Kensho that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review s&P Global financial data in Kensho.
